aim_summary.goal: Increase the forward-projecting length of the black operating lever by 5 cm.
preserve_targets: F008 properties other than the requested forward length increase
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The black operating lever projects 5 cm farther toward the model front, increasing manual reach while preserving its attachment and the remainder of the model.

operations_plan.summary: Extend the free end of operating lever shaft F008 by 5 cm toward the semantic front.

steps.description: Continue the complete section of planar free-end FACE 529 outward by 5 cm and unite the extension with SOLID 55.

expected_result.geometry: Operating lever shaft F008 retains its original attachment and cross-sectional characteristics while its planar free end projects exactly 5 cm farther toward semantic front (+Y).
expected_result.function: The longer lever provides improved access for manual manipulation.
expected_result.behavior: The lever's manipulation region is positioned farther toward the front while retaining its existing attachment relationship.

validation_criteria.description: The forward-projecting length of F008 is exactly 5 cm greater than in the original model.
The added lever volume continues outward from FACE 529 toward semantic front (+Y).
The extended lever provides increased manual access for manipulation.
The lever presents its manipulation region farther toward the front than before.
F008 remains black and retains its original attachment, cross section, and non-length characteristics except at the necessarily extended free end.
All geometry outside operating lever section R04 remains unchanged.
